circuit.name: Simulation-ka wareegga
circuit.problems: {n} dhibaato ayaa ku jira wareegga (eeg Dhibaato).
circuit.honesty: Xalinta aan leenahay, oo lagu hubiyay qaababka caadiga ah ee xisaabta. Qiime kasta oo qayb ah waad qortaa; ma akhrinno, ma ku darno moodeelada qaybaha ee soo saarayaasha, faylasha Multisim ma furi karno.
circuit.cmd.help: Fur daaqadda Simulation-ka wareegga: sawir wareeg oo samee simulation-kiisa.
ed.name: Magaca netka
ed.hint.select: Guji pin, kadibna pin kale si aad u sawirto silig. Jiid qayb si aad u guurto. R wuu leexiyaa, Delete wuu tirtiraa.
ed.hint.place: Guji sawirka si aad u dhigto {part}. Esc wuu joojiyaa.
ed.hint.name: Guji pin si aad netkiisa magac u siiso. Netka magaciisu yahay 0 ama gnd waa dhulka.
ed.hint.wire: Guji pin si aad siligga u dhamaysid, goob bannaan si aad isku xidhka u dhigto, ama silig si aad isugu xidho. Laba jeer guji ama Esc wuu joojiyaa.
ed.name.label: Magaca netka ee {pin}
ed.nosel: Dooro qayb si aad qiimaheeda u beddesho.
ed.wire.selected: Silig ayaa la doortay. Delete wuu tirtiraa.
chk.noground: Wareegga ma lahan dhul. Dhig calaamadda Dhulka ama u magacow net 0 ama gnd.
chk.duptag: Laba qayb ayaa magac u ah {tag}.
chk.twonames: Netyada {names} silig ayaa isku xidhay: mid ka mid ah waa gaabis ama magac qaldan.
chk.dcpath: Netka {node} ma lahan jid DC oo dhulka u gasha, sidaas darteed fooltiisa wareegga ma go'an. Ku dar reesistor dhulka u xidha ama jid hagaajin.
chk.sourceloop: {tag} wuxuu xidhaa wareeg ah ilaha foolti iyo induktorrada; korontada wareegga ma go'an. Dhig reesistor yar wareegga.
chk.shorted: {tag} labada dhamaadkiisa waxay ku jiraan net isku mid ah.
netlist.badvalue: {tag}: {field} waa "{text}", taasoo aan ahayn tiro. Isticmaal 4.7k, 100n, 1meg (m waa milli, meg waa mega).
netlist.notpositive: {tag}: {field} waa "{text}"; waa inuu ka weyn yahay eber.
run.empty: Sawirku waa madhan yahay. Dhig qaybo, ama soo gali tusaalaha.
run.badtime: Waqtiga dhammaadka iyo tallaabadu waa inay noqdaan tiro ka weyn eber.
run.toomanysteps: Taas waa ka badan {max} tallaabo. Isticmaal tallaabo weyn ama waqti dhammaad gaaban.
run.badfreq: Tijaabadu waxay u baahan tahay bilow ka weyn eber iyo dhammaad ka weyn bilowga.
run.toomanypoints: Taas waa ka badan {max} soo noqnoqod. Isticmaal dhibco yar tobanaankiiba ama kala duwanaansho gaaban.
run.noacsource: Ilaha ma lahan cabbir AC. Deji "Cabbirka AC ee tijaabada" ilaha DC ama garaaca, ama isticmaal ilaha AC.
run.noscope: Dhig iskoob net ah si aad u aragto foolkiisa waqtiga ku saabsan.
run.noplot: Dhig qorfe net ah si aad u aragto jawaabtiisa soo noqnoqoshada ku saabsan.
res.currentnote: Korontada qaybta ayay ka marto pin-kii koowaad ilaa kii labaad (ilaha: + ilaa -, sidaas darteed batari korontada bixisa wuxuu akhrisaa mid taban).
file.newask: Ma bilaabaa wareeg cusub oo madhan? Kan sawirka saaran ayaa la beddelayaa.
file.dropped: Waa la furay, laakiin {n} shay oo faylka ku jiray ma ahayn kuwo sax ah, waana laga reebay.
file.notcircuit: Faylkaas ma aha fayl Simulation-ka wareegga.
file.version: Faylkaas nooca {v} ayuu yahay; kordhintan wuxuu akhriyaa nooca 1.
file.symbol: Qayb ku jirta faylka ma sax ahayn, waana laga reebay.
file.wire: Silig ku jira faylka ma xidhin laba pin, waana laga reebay.
file.label: Magac net ku jira faylka ma lahayn pin, waana laga reebay.
